npm.transaction.id.rule: on every reached loadTransaction helper, upsert lowercase 0x plus the exact 32-byte transaction hash

npm.transaction.block_number.rule: on every reached loadTransaction helper, overwrite with the exact event block number

npm.transaction.timestamp.rule: on every reached loadTransaction helper, overwrite with the exact event block timestamp

npm.transaction.gas_used.rule: segment-selected: apiVersion 0.0.4 stores transaction gas_limit; apiVersion 0.0.7 stores zero; receipt gas is never used

npm.transaction.gas_price.rule: on every reached loadTransaction helper, overwrite with the exact transaction gas price

npm.position.identity.rule: new identity uses the decimal NPM token id; an existing Position id is preserved

npm.position.owner.rule: a provisional new Position starts at zero address; Transfer assigns event.to; other handlers preserve owner

npm.position.liquidity.rule: Increase adds event liquidity, Decrease subtracts event liquidity, Collect and Transfer preserve the prior value

npm.position.deposited_token0.rule: Increase adds decimal(event.amount0, token0.decimals); other handlers preserve the prior value

npm.position.deposited_token1.rule: Increase adds decimal(event.amount1, token1.decimals); other handlers preserve the prior value

npm.position.withdrawn_token0.rule: Decrease adds decimal(event.amount0, token0.decimals); other handlers preserve the prior value

npm.position.withdrawn_token1.rule: Decrease adds decimal(event.amount1, token1.decimals); other handlers preserve the prior value

npm.position.collected_fees_token0.rule: Collect uses the exact segment NPM profile final expression; other handlers preserve the prior value

npm.position.collected_fees_token1.rule: Collect uses the exact segment NPM profile final expression; other handlers preserve the prior value

npm.position.creation_transaction.rule: a new Position stores its first successfully persisted identity-creation transaction; existing Position.transaction is never overwritten

npm.position.fee_growth_inside0.rule: new identity starts from positions(); Increase, Decrease, and Collect replace it from successful try_positions; revert and Transfer preserve it

npm.position.fee_growth_inside1.rule: new identity starts from positions(); Increase, Decrease, and Collect replace it from successful try_positions; revert and Transfer preserve it

npm.snapshot.identity.rule: accepted handler stores token id plus # plus block number; the last accepted same-Position event in a block overwrites it

npm.snapshot.position.rule: copy the accepted Position decimal token id

npm.snapshot.block_number.rule: copy the exact current block number

npm.snapshot.timestamp.rule: copy the exact current block timestamp

npm.snapshot.copy_position.rule: copy the accepted post-handler value of the same-named certified Position field

npm.snapshot.current_transaction.rule: store the current accepted handler transaction; last accepted same-Position event in a block overwrites it

flash.pool.fee_growth_0.rule: after Pool load, decode exact 32-byte uint256 from feeGrowthGlobal0X128() calldata f3058399; persist only after fee1 also succeeds

flash.pool.fee_growth_1.rule: after fee0 succeeds, decode exact 32-byte uint256 from feeGrowthGlobal1X128() calldata 46141319; atomically save both fields once

required_absence.no_store_set_target.rule: no direct, dynamic, or indirect store.set target exists for the entity in any function of all 20 retained mapping artifacts

residual_field_blockers.reason: the executable host reducer retains address/tick values but does not prove exact Graph serialized relation ids for these stored link fields

npm.nonfatal_error: discard the failing joint handler scratch state and continue
